title: German-Style Pork Belly Baozi
description: A twist on traditional Chinese baozi, this German-inspired version features slow-cooked pork belly in a sweet and spicy sauce.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and five-spice powder in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Meanwhile, cook the pork belly in a large pot of boiling water until tender, about 2 hours.
Drain the pork belly and let cool to room temperature.
Combine sriracha and ginger in a small bowl.
Split the risen dough into 8 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a piece of pork belly in the center of each dough circle, brush the edges with egg wash, and fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape.
Bake the baozi in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
